I haven't changed anything.

The test output also includes a lot of DEBUG logging from `ledger.sync`. It includes repeated `skipping unknown account 'legacy-card'` lines, which aren't failures but might be worth knowing about.

I've saved your rule not to edit `generated/` to memory so it applies in future sessions too.
